text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, is that everyone? Let's kick off 
the joint Miho and Rittou Dorm New Year's 
party!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yaaay~.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Where are the Tiara girls who made such a 
big splash last year?! Let your senior 
give you a hug!! The one on the 
unconventional path, the one who conquered 
an American G1...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Besides... Mmmph! Sweeeeep! 
Congratulations to you too on winning the 
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Half a year has already passed, but 
is it still okay to celebrate?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of coooourse! Praise me until your heart's 
content!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Looks like the new generation has 
completely taken over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...For the record, Senpai, I once aimed 
for first place in the Takarazuka Kinen 
too, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Does it frustrate you to have the throne 
you aimed for stolen away?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, quite the opposite. I'm simply filled 
with feelings of wanting to congratulate 
them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Being able to watch over our juniors' 
successes ...is truly the privilege of a 
senior Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha... To think Dober would be talking 
about senior Umamusume like this now.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, Hishi Amazon-senpai. Would you mind if 
I changed the TV channel?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ! Yeah! Is there a show you want to watch?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Craft and the others are on a live 
broadcast! Umm, if I remember correctly—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, here are our next two guests! 
Give it up for Cesario and Rhein Kraft!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Whoaa~... It's TV, actual TV! I'm on 
TV...! ...I wonder if Mom is recording 
this~?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Mun!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, speaking of the "Faces of Last 
Year," while a hero did emerge on the 
Classic Triple Crown route... the two of 
you also had a thrilling, stellar run!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
I totally get it~! Watching Craft-san 
challenge the unconventional Double Crown 
got my heart racing like crazy too~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Apparently so, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wahya~... Tee-hee.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Craft! That's where you're supposed 
to stand proud!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly. It's a broadcast where you can 
showcase your value!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu. You two get along so well~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if those girls will be the ones 
leading the Tiara route this year?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I believe so. Trends are always shifting, 
after all♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
From upperclassman to underclassman. And 
from that underclassman to the next 
generation.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—And so, trends eventually become the 
'past.' Fading into a person of mere 
records that nobody remembers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, you too?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Trends change so quickly, after all. 
Long ago, it already—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run in the greatest race, more 
amazing than any of my Tiara seniors!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
First, I want to master lightning-fast 
blitz races like Flower-san and Pearl-san, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Just like Hishi Amazon-san and North 
Flight-san, I want to have a showdown with 
my rival too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, you'd want a tough body 
like Ikuno Dictus-san's, so you won't get 
injured no matter how many races you 
run...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Craft, it seems there are so many 
backs you wish to pursue.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! There are tons of them! So many 
runners whose backs I want to catch up to!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"In the upcoming Takamatsunomiya Kinen, 
just like Daiichi Ruby-san—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...In her eyes though, it seems she sees 
you as someone she has to surpass."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha—you're right. And here I haven't run 
in quite a while.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
――... Ahaha. What do I do? This... might 
actually make me way too happy.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Greaaat work~! Craft-san! I'll be rooting 
for you in the next Takamatsunomiya Kinen 
too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, was it really okay for me to 
declare that earlier...? I just couldn't 
hold it in anymore...
choice_data_list:
Did I really make such a strange 
declaration?
Did I make such a weird declaration?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: You were totally doing it, you know!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run in the greatest race, more 
amazing than any of my Tiara seniors!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Did that upset the upperclassmen, I 
wonder? A youngster getting way ahead of 
herself...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Then Craft, how would you feel if a junior 
told you, 'I want to surpass the 
Craft-senpai I adore so much'?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh. I'm so happy.
choice_data_list:
I'm sure the upperclassmen feel the same 
way.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah, a phone call.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Fufu. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's from Hishi Ama-san. She said she'll 
save some food from the New Year's party 
until we get back.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh, seriously?!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's dash back to the academy!

Go ahead and talk directly with the 
upperclassmen.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wahooo~~! Yay~! Hishi Ama-san's cooking is 
an absolute masterpiece~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Alrighty then. Which dish should I 
start refilling first?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: My cake!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. Craft's and Cesario's portions 
take top priority.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...If it's for my cute juniors, I'll make 
enough for everyone, though."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes! Understood!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *phew*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, Trainer. Excuse me, do you have a 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Please call a taxi immediately!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you're willing to come along, but 
still! Humans do have limits, you know?!
choice_data_list: Still, I was the one who suggested it...
Still, I was the one who suggested it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah... Traiiiineeeer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And after meeting up with Cesario, who 
had taken a separate taxi, we made it back 
to the Academy."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
! You're right! I'll ask a bunch about 
tactics and mindset!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Easier said than done, though...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Wherever I look—)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Even looking over that way――)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Who should I talk to first~~?! Everyone 
here is so amazing~~!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Be more assertive, Craft. You promised the 
Trainer, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuugh... I know that, but stillll...! 
Wait just a little longer. Let me prepare 
myself—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Craft-chan! About that TV show from 
earlier—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eep...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Look, Craft, here's your chance! Go on—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Craft?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...She's totally frozen.
